mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following a low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests labor market weakness, which could negatively impact consumer spending and lead to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following an unemployment rate increase.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate coupled with stagnant employment growth indicates a weakening labor market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following simultaneous increases in UNRATE and stagnant PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects stronger demand in the housing market, which may boost related industries and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following a housing starts increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP suggests reduced economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following a GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates supply chain issues, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following an industrial production decline.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slowing GDP growth and rising retail sales suggests a consumption-driven expansion, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following the observed pattern.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer prices may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following a CPI increase.
